Stay in touch with MSP

Leave your email and we will send you the dates of our online Q&As, the application deadlines and news from the programme.

By signing up you agree that the Maastricht Science Programme (Maastricht University) may email you about MSP: Q&A dates, deadlines and news. We use your name and email address only for this and never share them. If you start studying with us, we will use only your UM email account for education-related correspondence; please start using it as soon as the Student Services Centre gives you a student ID. If you do not accept your place with us, or decide not to study with us, we delete your name and personal email address on 1 September 2027 at the latest. To be removed earlier, email msp-admissions@maastrichtuniversity.nl.

Thank you.

You are on the list. Look out for an email with our Q&A dates, and enjoy the rest of the open day.
